launchEffect: Effect when launching from a cover
launchEffectHint: Choose the animation used when launching games from library covers.
freezeHint: Ice covers and cracks the card, then melts away in the center.
shatterHint: The cover shatters and reassembles in the center.
shrinkHint: The card shrinks away and grows back in the center.
penguinHint: Tux slides across the cover while you hold to start or stop.
particlesHint: The cover dissolves into particles and rebuilds in the center.
aquariumHint: Water fills the cover and pours into the center, revealing the game.
smoothHint: The cover moves to the center with a smooth transition.
noLaunchEffectHint: Disables holding the cover to start or stop. Open the details to launch the game.
projectHint: Update the backend for your graphics card.
distributionHint: Download, update or uninstall Proton versions.
steamConfirmMessage: Valve's official Proton builds are designed for Steam and may require additional components or adjustments for games outside Steam. For PeliGames, prefer GE-Proton or Proton-CachyOS. If you continue, installed Proton versions detected in Steam will also appear in the Proton selector.
experimentalUpdatesHint: Also offers the beta and experimental versions on GitHub, before the stable release. They may have bugs. When off, the launcher only offers stable versions.

logsHint: PeliGames events and failures, with automatic cleanup.
